token.title: 🔑 Tohu uru GitHub
token.intro: Ka whakautu a GitHub i ngā tono e 60 i te hāora ki tētahi wāhitau kāore e tuku tohu uru. Tata ki te 32 te utu o tētahi rākau pāoka katoa, nō reira ka maroke te toronga tuarua. Ka hiki te tohu uru i te tuanui ki te 5000 i te hāora.
token.step1: Huakina te Settings, te Developer settings, te Personal access tokens, te Fine-grained tokens, kātahi ko Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: tōu ake pūkete. Expiration: he rā noa iho, kāore te rākau e hiahia ki tētahi mea roa te ora.
token.step4: Waiho ngā whakaaetanga katoa kia kore e pāngia. Kāore he whakaaetanga e hiahiatia ana e te meta o ngā pātaka tūmatanui.
token.step5: Waihangatia, kātahi ka tāruatia te uara {token}. Kotahi anake te wā ka whakaaturia e GitHub.
token.classic: Ka pai hoki tētahi tohu uru tawhito: waihangatia me te kore whānuitanga kua tohua. Ka pānui tonu te whānuitanga kau i ngā raraunga tūmatanui i te pāpātanga motuhēhē.
token.stays: Ka noho ki tēnei pūtirotiro i raro i te kī {key}, ā, ka haere ki {host} anake. Kāore rawa e tuhia ki te pae wāhitau, nō reira ka kawe te hono ka tiria e koe i te tirohanga, ehara i te taipitopito tuakiri. Mā te pātene i raro i te āpure e muku anō, tahi me te keteroki.
token.persistHow: Whakaurua te tohu uru ki te kōnae {env} o te tūmau e manaaki ana i tēnei whārangi, i te taha o {port}:
token.proxy: ā, tīmatahia ki te {make}. Kātahi ka tuhia e te ipu he kongakonga nginx e tāpiri ana i te pane {header} ki tētahi takawaenga {path}, nō reira ka karanga te pūtirotiro ki tōna ake pūtake, ā, kāore rawa e whiwhi i te tohu uru. Ka ngaro tēnei āpure, ā, ka tiria e ngā manuhiri katoa te tahua kotahi o te 5000 i te hāora.
fork.refused404: Kāore he rārangi peka: {message}. Ko te 404 i konei he peka kāore i te tīari, he ara rānei kāore e kawea e te takawaenga tūmau; ahakoa ko tēhea, kua oti katoa te kōtuitui pāoka i runga.
fork.refusedExhausted: Kua pau ngā tono a GitHub mō tēnei hāora, nō reira kāore i taea te tuhi rārangi peka. Kua oti katoa te kōtuitui pāoka i runga. Tāpirihia he tohu uru ki te paewhiri tātari, whakawetohia rānei ngā rārangi peka i te paewhiri hoahoa kia whakapaua te tahua ki te kōtuitui anake.
fork.refusedOther: I whakahoki a GitHub i te {status} mō ngā hītori tukunga, nō reira kāore i taea te tuhi rārangi peka. Kua oti katoa te kōtuitui pāoka i runga.
